entities.name: Kumena
entities.description: A River Herald Shaper, leader of his people, who reaches Orazca first, takes the power of the Immortal Sun and is thrown from the tower by vampires.

entities.name: Tishana
entities.description: A River Herald rival whom Kumena evades by using little magic.

entities.name: Vona of Iedo
entities.description: A vampire conquistador who attacks Kumena and throws him from the window.

entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: A vampire hierophant who joins Vona in attacking Kumena.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker whose lost memories flood back after a fall at Orazca.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker and assassin who shares Jace's memories and comforts him.

entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: A sphinx who manipulated and tortured Jace's mind and whose own mind Jace shattered in a remembered fight.

entities.name: Emmara
entities.description: One of the few friends Jace names after regaining his memories.

entities.name: Nissa
entities.description: One of the few friends Jace names after regaining his memories.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whom Jace toasts in a remembered conversation.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city containing the Immortal Sun that rises from the jungle.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: A relic embedded in the floor of Orazca's central tower that Kumena claims.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where Orazca rises.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where Jace and Vraska first met and where Jace once got tattoos.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Jace's home plane, a gritty frontier with a large circular structure.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane named in a remembered conversation.

entities.name: Stormwreck Sea
entities.description: The sea where Vraska captained her ship in a remembered scene.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: The merfolk of Ixalan whom Kumena leads.

entities.name: Ochran
entities.description: An assassins' group to which Vraska's fellow assassins belonged.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose shaman gave Jace his first tattoos.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose folk song Vraska sings.

entities.name: Thaumatic Compass
entities.description: The compass that points to the central tower.

events.summary: Kumena nears Orazca using little magic to avoid Tishana.
events.quote: He was nearing the golden city of Orazca, the resting place of the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: Kumena climbs the great staircase and enters Orazca.
events.quote: Kumena ascended to the golden city at last.

events.summary: A voice from the golden walls calls Kumena to set it free.
events.quote: Kumena the Shaper, child of the Great River, leader of your people. Come set me free.

events.summary: Kumena realizes the voice is his own reflected power.
events.quote: The voice was deep and commanding, the voice of a leader. It was his own.

events.summary: The voice calls itself the Sun and tells Kumena to follow it through the labyrinth.
events.quote: I am the Sun, Kumena. As you will be.

events.summary: Kumena reaches the central tower and finds the Immortal Sun embedded in the floor.
events.quote: He stepped into the chamber, and beheld the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: Kumena steps onto the Immortal Sun and takes its power.
events.quote: Kumena stepped onto the Immortal Sun and took that power, his power.

events.summary: Kumena raises the city from the ground, opening a canyon around it and flooding it with rivers.
events.quote: He flexed his fingers, and the city lurched upward, separating from the rock around it.

events.summary: Kumena's laughter is cut short when Vona confronts him atop the Sun.
events.quote: Kumena turned his physical form, the one that stood atop the Immortal Sun, and locked eyes with a vampire.

events.summary: Vona and Mavren Fein tackle Kumena and wound him.
events.quote: The vampires scratched and bit, and one of their swords sliced a long line into Kumena's side.

events.summary: Vona throws Kumena out of the tower window.
events.quote: before Kumena could react, she threw him out the window.

events.summary: Jace lies bleeding on the riverbank, his mind broadcasting memories.
events.quote: Jace lay in agony on the riverbank.

events.summary: Vraska realizes Jace's injury has left his mind unable to contain his memories.
events.quote: He broadcasted his memories now in bursts and stops, clearly trying to wrestle them back under control.

events.summary: Vraska is hit by an image of a broken white brick barrier at a harbor on a plane she has never visited.
events.quote: There was a massive barrier made of white brick against a turbulent sky.

events.summary: Vraska sees a memory of a half-metal man scarring Jace's back and forearm.
events.quote: dragged a manablade in long, arrow-straight lines down his back, then one single line down his right forearm

events.summary: Vraska sees a memory of a teenage Jace getting white tattoos from a Gruul shaman on Ravnica.
events.quote: The shaman leaned over the teenager and drew a line with his finger down Jace's cheek, leaving a brilliant white tattoo in its place.

events.summary: Vraska witnesses a memory of Jace asking a woman in violet if she will be sad when he dies.
events.quote: Will you be sad when I die?

events.summary: The woman in violet gives a cold answer, then pours drinks and toasts to new good old days to keep Jace there.
events.quote: To new good old days,

events.summary: Jace chokes out the name Vryn as a memory of his home plane floods in.
events.quote: He choked out a single word.

events.summary: Vraska sees a memory of Jace's mother reading to him as a toddler.
events.quote: She was reading to her toddler from a notebook as she wandered the tiny kitchen

events.summary: Vraska sees that Jace was forced to forget his first planeswalks and mentally violated every time he remembered.
events.quote: the realization he had been forced to forget his first planeswalk

events.summary: Vraska experiences Jace's memory of facing the sphinx Alhammarret on a rooftop.
events.quote: the sphinx Alhammarret was crouched to attack in front of her.

events.summary: Jace's mind-strike collapses Alhammarret's mind in a catastrophic implosion (flashback).
events.quote: What was a well of weathered marble violently collapsed against itself in a catastrophic implosion that deafened the senses.

events.summary: Jace's own memories are ripped away in the psychic backlash.
events.quote: But Jace had struck out too hungrily, too hard, and his own memories were ripped away in the process of psychic demolition.

events.summary: Alhammarret, mind destroyed, screams like an infant.
events.quote: It was the terrified howl of an infant.

events.summary: Jace instinctively planeswalks away, losing more memories as he goes.
events.quote: Jace began to instinctively planeswalk away

events.summary: Only the image of the sphinx's collar symbol remains in Jace's memory.
events.quote: All that remained was the image of the sphinx's collar

events.summary: Vraska holds the weeping Jace, the first time she has touched anyone willingly in years.
events.quote: Vraska instantly dove to the ground and scooped him into her arms.

events.summary: Jace's memory shows Vraska singing a Golgari song aboard her ship.
events.quote: this Vraska was singing a Golgari folk song at the top of her lungs as her crew cleaned the ship.

events.summary: Jace's memory shows Vraska as a menacing figure the first time they met.
events.quote: It was the first time they had met.

events.summary: Jace says Vraska saw everything and acknowledges she is an assassin; she answers she is also a friend.
events.quote: You're an assassin

events.summary: Jace says his memory is not fully back and has gaps.
events.quote: It's not all back. There are gaps.

events.summary: Vraska apologizes for trying to kill Jace on Ravnica.
events.quote: I'm sorry I tried to kill you on Ravnica,

events.summary: Jace forgives Vraska for trying to kill him.
events.quote: I forgive you for trying to kill me,

events.summary: Vraska checks the compass, which points straight at the central tower.
events.quote: its light pointed an arrow-straight line toward the tower.

events.summary: Jace says the last three months were the best of his life.
events.quote: It was the best three months of my life.

events.summary: Vraska tells Jace the person who listened to her is who he really is.
events.quote: That Jace is still in you, and I think that Jace is who you really are.

events.summary: Jace speaks of his mother wanting him to be a scholar.
events.quote: My mother wanted me to move to the city to be a scholar.

events.summary: Vraska helps Jace up and they start to climb the staircase to Orazca.
events.quote: Vraska held out a hand to help Jace to his feet.

events.summary: Jace admits he used to be a coward as they climb.
events.quote: I used to be a coward.

relations.note: The mentor who betrayed and manipulated Jace.
relations.quote: She saw how this mentor had betrayed him

relations.note: Jace shattered Alhammarret's mind in self-defense.
relations.quote: Jace reached out defensively with his own mind.
What do you say, Mavren Fein?

relations.note: She throws him out the window.
relations.quote: before Kumena could react, she threw him out the window.

relations.note: The voice calls him leader of his people.
relations.quote: Kumena the Shaper, child of the Great River, leader of your people.

relations.note: He avoids magic so Tishana cannot find him.
relations.quote: Any greater act of spellcraft would have led Tishana straight to him.
One of her fellow assassins in the Ochran had grown quick-tempered after such a blow when she was younger.
